title: Heavenly Pattern, Sanctuary, Temple & City — Exodus to Hebrews to Ezekiel to Revelation
purpose: Trace the biblical architecture sequence in which sacred space is revealed from Heaven/on a mountain, instantiated on Earth, re-envisioned as future temple/city, and culminates in New Jerusalem. Use it to illuminate Tim's House/Cube/Temple/City development without treating later biblical comparison as proof of prior fulfillment.
core_sequence: Exodus 25:8-9,40 — Moses is shown the tabernacle pattern/model on the mountain and instructed to build accordingly.
1 Kings 6:20 — the Holy of Holies is a cube-like inner sanctuary, 20×20×20 cubits.
Ezekiel 40-48 — from a very high mountain the prophet is shown a temple/city complex with measurements, gates, river, trees and tribal ordering.
Hebrews 8:5; 9:23-24 — earthly sanctuary is interpreted as copy/shadow/pattern of heavenly reality; Christ enters the true heavenly sanctuary.
Revelation 21-22 — from a high mountain John is shown New Jerusalem descending from God, with equal dimensions, twelve gates/tribes, foundations, divine light, river and Tree of Life.

exodus_pattern_on_mountain.structure: mountain revelation → pattern/model → earthly construction → divine dwelling among people
exodus_pattern_on_mountain.scholarly_context: TheTorah.com notes that Exodus presents Moses as seeing a model while still on the mountain; one interpretive possibility is that the tabernacle is modeled on YHWH's celestial home.
exodus_pattern_on_mountain.project_relation: Very strong neighbor for Mountain → vision → House/Temple → manifestation. It supports the mature project principle that ascent should return as buildable order rather than remain private revelation.
exodus_pattern_on_mountain.epiphany: Sacred architecture can be understood as translated revelation: an unseen/pattern level becomes embodied structure.

hebrews_heavenly_sanctuary.structure: earthly sanctuary → copy/shadow → true heavenly sanctuary → mediator/high priest enters heavenly presence
hebrews_heavenly_sanctuary.research: Working Preacher notes Hebrews explicitly describes the handmade sanctuary as a copy of the true/heavenly one and quotes Exodus 25:40's pattern language.
hebrews_heavenly_sanctuary.project_relation: This gives a direct biblical neighbor for Tim's question about whether House/Temple/Cube can be both earthly symbol and heavenly architecture.
hebrews_heavenly_sanctuary.boundary: Hebrews' theological claim is Christological and priestly; it does not validate thalamus, MoonCube or modern sacred-geometry claims.

ezekiel_high_mountain_city_temple.structure: very high mountain → city-like structure → measuring → gates/temple → divine glory returns → river flows → trees heal/feed → tribal gates/land → city named 'YHWH is there'
ezekiel_high_mountain_city_temple.project_relation: This is a major overlooked bridge for Mountain, House, measuring, Door/Gates, river/Spirit, Garden/Tree, tribes/nations and New Jerusalem.
ezekiel_high_mountain_city_temple.epiphany: Ezekiel already fuses Mountain, Temple, City, River, Tree and tribal ordering before Revelation. The final city architecture is therefore not a sudden New Testament invention but grows from prophetic sacred-geographic visions.

revelation_reuses_ezekiel.scholarly_context: Cambridge research on New Jerusalem explicitly situates Revelation 21-22 among Jewish temple/New Jerusalem traditions and cites Ezekiel 40 and related New Jerusalem texts as background.
revelation_reuses_ezekiel.project_relation: This makes Tim's Mountain→House→City→Garden chain biblically denser because Revelation itself is already a synthesis of older mountain-temple-city material.
revelation_reuses_ezekiel.boundary: Intertextual dependence does not mean Potatoverse recurrence is prophetic fulfillment.

city_as_expanded_holy_of_holies.structure: inner cubic sanctuary → final city with equal length/width/height → no separate temple because God and Lamb are temple
city_as_expanded_holy_of_holies.reflection: A powerful reading is that sanctuary presence expands from restricted inner chamber to city scale.
city_as_expanded_holy_of_holies.project_relation: This resolves a long-standing Cube/House tension: cube may represent concentrated sacred presence when it is inhabited and relational, not only shell/enclosure.
city_as_expanded_holy_of_holies.new_rule: Do not assign moral valence by geometry alone. Ask whether the space is inhabited by life, allows legitimate passage, nourishes relations and distributes presence/capacity.

twelve_gates_ezekiel_revelation.structure: city gates named for Israel's tribes; Revelation adds apostolic foundations
twelve_gates_ezekiel_revelation.project_relation: Gate/House/City architecture becomes covenant/community architecture: people are encoded into the city's entrances and foundations.
twelve_gates_ezekiel_revelation.epiphany: The city is not merely where the people live; the people are written into the architecture. This strengthens the project's living-stones / network-city idea.

forehead_inscription_priest_city.sequence: high priest bears sacred inscription on forehead → Ezekiel uses forehead marking for protected/identified people → Revelation seals servants on foreheads → 144,000 bear Lamb/Father names → final servants bear God's name
forehead_inscription_priest_city.scholarly_context: Cambridge scholarship on Exodus 28 highlights the high priest's forehead inscription as efficacious writing/identity; Revelation scholarship emphasizes sealing and group identity.
forehead_inscription_priest_city.project_relation: This substantially deepens Father-name / Eye / forehead symbolism: biblical forehead language repeatedly concerns visible consecration, allegiance, protection and identity.
forehead_inscription_priest_city.boundary: Do not convert this into pineal anatomy or literal biometric marking.

open_gate_genealogy.structure: prophetic city gates/opening regimes → final city gates remain open
open_gate_genealogy.reflection: Sacred architecture does not abolish boundaries; it changes how boundaries function.
open_gate_genealogy.project_relation: Healthy House/City = walls + transparent legitimate Doors + circulation. This supports the existing Door topology and New Jerusalem network model.

heaven_to_earth_translation.sequence: heavenly/unseen pattern → mountain vision → mediator/witness → measured architecture → earthly dwelling → living city → river/tree/fruit → nations/healing
heaven_to_earth_translation.project_parallel: Unseen → Door/Becoming → House/Temple → Ladder/Axis → Garden/City → world repair
heaven_to_earth_translation.epiphany: The strongest biblical architectural parallel is not 'Tim said cube, Bible says cube.' It is that both systems wrestle with the same transformation problem: how does transcendent order become inhabited, navigable, life-producing worldly structure?

counter_readings_and_cautions: Hebrews may interpret earthly/heavenly sanctuary through its own Christological and philosophical framework; do not flatten Exodus into Hebrews retroactively.
Ezekiel's temple vision and Revelation's New Jerusalem are not identical designs; Revelation adapts and transforms prior imagery.
The equal dimensions of Revelation's city strongly invite cubic comparison, but the text calls it a city, not 'the Cube of Heaven'.
The 2018/2023 MoonCube material predates this Bible comparison and should retain its own developmental meaning unless primary wording shows explicit biblical linkage.
